error_message: Cannot build this strategy without definitions of sell_below10() and sell_abv10(). Specify the exit condition for each profit range and which rule applies when trade profit is exactly 10%. Trade profit will be measured from the next-open entry price; final signals will not be shifted.
compute_moving_average_signal() got an unexpected keyword argument 'short_window'

Cannot build the strategy without definitions of sell_below10() and sell_abv10(): the specification selects an exit rule based on trade profit but does not specify either rule's exit condition. Also specify which rule applies when profit equals exactly 10%. Profit thresholds alone are not exit triggers, and treating them as such would invent a take-profit rule.
Provide df['longcondition'] as a causal Boolean indicator; the strategy specification does not define how to calculate it.
